title: 第13章 朱果第14章 危机
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 次日一早，孙冰依旧开始了每天不简单的操练，虽然并没有让他领悟一些什么东西，但是对于剑的熟练度更深了，出招的速度更快了，哪怕仅仅只有一丝，也是巨大的进步。
经过了整整一个晚上的沉淀，现在的孙冰对于自己的力量也有了一个初步的掌控，手持木剑能够在同一时间划破十片坠落的树叶，而且刺向山壁的洞更深了，这些都代表着孙冰的进步。
可有了这样的进步，孙冰依旧是眉头紧皱，因为他清楚，一味地闭门造车是不行的，继续锻炼下去的话，顶多是能够加深自己对于剑法的领悟。
可现在，基础剑法已经圆满了，至少目前的孙冰根本就不知晓应该如何提升，至于《纵剑诀》也已经小成，但是距离大成还有一个瓶颈，现在也根本不知道如何突破，更何况昨天境界刚刚提升，现在也不能继续提升了。
这么计算下来，此刻的孙冰颇有种不知道如何变强，经过思索之后，才暗道：“应该出去磨砺自身了。”
毕竟“不经一番寒彻骨，怎得梅花扑鼻香”，就算孙冰已经把所有的剑法都练习到圆满的程度了，若没有实战经验，没有高深的对敌技巧，一切都是空谈。
等到真正碰上敌人的时候，自己甚至只能发挥二分之一乃至于四分之一的实力，碰到这种情况，死亡的话，就太冤枉了。
不过想要增加对敌经验其实相当简单，只需要出了落云镇，不远处就是横断山脉，其中不仅仅有珍贵的天材地宝，而且还有无数的妖兽。
可千万不能小瞧这些妖兽，因为天地间灵气的作用，它们也能够或主动或被动的尽兴修炼，直至最后突破变成了妖兽，其战力一点都不下于人类。
一阶妖兽相当于淬体境前期，二阶则是淬体境中期，三阶是淬体境后期，至于四阶妖兽，则相当于练气境界的修士，传说发展到最后，妖兽能够化人，按照人类的修炼境界划分，至于到底要什么等级才能化人，孙冰也不知晓。
不过横断山脉中主要是一至三阶妖兽，就算是四阶妖兽都相当稀少，因此，相当适合此刻的孙冰，既没有太过危险，也不至于太安逸，若是运气足够好，还有着种种机缘，一定能够让孙冰的剑道更上一层楼。
当即，孙冰手持那柄墨色的木剑，整理了一下衣裳，携带好一些行李，便朝着山下走去。
经过落云镇口，便能够看到来来往往的行人，最主要的还是那些散修，这一群人因为没有师承，所以生活相当艰难，最主要的收入来源就是进入横断山脉寻找天材地宝，亦或者猎杀妖兽贩卖。
可是他们本就实力有些欠缺，每一次进入横断山脉更像是一种搏命，而不是历练，而这也就造成了恶性循环，每月搏命的钱仅仅只够日常所需，那么就没有多余的资源用于修炼。
所以实力一直得不到增强，只能苟延残存，这就是弱者的悲哀，与他们相比，孙冰最起码庆幸了不少，最起码一开始的起点就不一样。
有些悲哀的望了那些来来往往的散修，孙冰的脚步不由得更加快了。
虽然说横断山脉就在落云镇旁，但也足足行走了小半日的光景，远远望去，就看见山脉中树木林立，时不时几只飞鸟掠过，带起阵阵微风。
这些可不是什么观赏类型的飞鸟，能在横断山脉中活下来的鸟类，没有一个是善茬，若就此轻视的话，一定会付出性命的代价。
当下，孙冰的精神也不由得谨慎了起来，一柄木剑紧紧的握在手中，要知道在这横断山脉中，纵然是淬体境九层的修士前来，也有一定的危险性，更何况不仅仅需要提防妖兽，还需要注意同类，一个不留神，那么就死无全尸。
一路朝着里面前进，只不过横断山脉外围早就已经被落云镇的散修探寻完毕了，所以根本就没有什么油水，反倒是三两只低阶妖兽时常蹦出，甚至在孙冰的剑下撑不过一招。
约莫走了一个时辰，周围的环境有了明显的变化，地上已经被枯叶所覆盖，根本就看不出什么人类行动的痕迹，这里似乎没有人前来，那么不仅仅代表着危险，同样也象征机遇。
孙冰目光微闭，这还是他的第一次冒险，心中虽然有股激动，可是身为剑客，必须要时刻保持冷静，同时，心中已经把警惕心提升到了最高。
突然间，孙冰的双目一凝，因为他发现，不远处的山谷有着明显的诡异，一株植物悄然而立，但它方圆一丈之内，竟然寸草不生，至于一丈之外，则草木茂盛。
若不是孙冰距离接近，根本就察觉不到其中的诡异，当下，他不由得朝前走了几步，只见这植物大概半人高，其中生长着一枚红色的果子，约莫大拇指大小，瞬间，孙冰就想起了这灵物的名称。
“没有想到我竟然也有此等机缘。”因为那一株明显就是传说中的朱果，而且看其生长程度，年份还不低，最少三十年以上，这才整个落云镇中，已经算是相当罕见的了。
这等灵果的功效非凡，其一为提升身体素质，就算是一个普普通通的凡人吃下一枚之后，也能立刻突破成为修士，而且还是直接突破至淬体三层境界，单单这一点，就让无数人疯狂了。
至于第二点，就是增加自己体内的真气，而三十年的朱果，能够帮人省下一年的苦修，可想而知其恐怖程度。
可以说，面前这一枚朱果是最为适合此刻孙冰的灵物了，只要能够拿到手，他有十成把握，能够立刻突破至淬体四层巅峰，甚至调整两日，到达淬体境五层也未尝不可。
但越是这个时候，就越是要忍耐，孙冰并不认为自己是什么真命天子，虽然此地有些偏僻，但也不至于他是第一个发现这枚朱果的人，当下不由得小心查探。
突然间，孙冰的脚似乎踩到了什么，低头一看，只见枯叶之下，竟然出现了一个白色的骷髅头，看其样子似乎已经有很多年的历史了。
当下孙冰立刻木剑轻挑，伴随着落叶飞舞，地上出现了令人震惊的一幕，入眼所见，最少五具白骨堆积在一块，这场面，哪怕孙冰的精神意志相当坚定，却也倒吸了一口气。
“此地到底是何等情况？怎么有这么多人葬身于此？”同时心中也不由得庆幸，幸亏自己没有被眼前的利益冲昏了头，若刚刚冲动的话，不知道此刻又会是如何？
同时这也让孙冰的心中敲响了警钟，现在的他远远没有达到天下无敌的地步，不管是面对何种情况，都需要冷静，尤其是面对未知的危险的时候。
伴随着这个声音，原先蹲在地上观察骷髅的孙冰仿佛嗅到了什么似的，右手木剑横空，连看都不看就向后方刺去，然后整个人立刻进行闪避，这才看清楚袭击他的元凶。
一条约莫三寸的长蛇此刻已经身首分离，甚至蛇身还在不住的跳动，此蛇浑身与周围的环境相仿，即便是已经死亡，身上的颜色竟然从原先的树叶绿变成了地上的枯叶。
“没有想到竟然是斑斓蛇。”这种蛇类仅仅只是二级妖兽，但是一身毒性惊人，纵然是练气境的修士毫无防备被咬了一口，最后也会身死，可想而知毒性猛烈。
更何况其隐藏功夫相当高深，若不是孙冰的洞察能力惊人的话，今天指不定也会中招。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Sun Bing still started the not-so-simple training every day. Although he didn't understand anything, his proficiency with the sword became deeper and his attack speed became faster. Even if it was just a little bit, it was a huge improvement.
After a whole night of preparation, Sun Bing now has preliminary control over his own power. The wooden sword he holds can cut through ten falling leaves at the same time, and the hole pierced into the mountain wall is deeper. These all represent Sun Bing's progress.
But with such progress, Sun Bing still frowned, because he knew that blindly practicing behind closed doors would not work. If he continued to practice, he would at most be able to deepen his understanding of swordsmanship.
But now, the basic swordsmanship has been perfected. At least for now, Sun Bing doesn't know how to improve it. As for "Zongjian Jue", he has already achieved a small degree of success, but there is still a bottleneck before reaching it. Now he doesn't know how to break through it. What's more, his level just improved yesterday and he can't continue to improve it now.
After calculating this, Sun Bing felt like he didn't know how to become stronger at this moment. After thinking about it, he secretly said: "It's time to go out and sharpen yourself."
After all, "How can plum blossoms smell fragrant without being chilled to the bone?" Even if Sun Bing has practiced all the swordsmanship to perfection, without actual combat experience and advanced enemy-fighting skills, everything is empty talk.
When he actually encounters the enemy, he can only use one-half or even one-fourth of his strength. In this situation, it would be an injustice to die.
However, it is actually quite simple to increase experience against enemies. You only need to leave Luoyun Town. Not far away is the Hengduan Mountains, which contain not only precious treasures of heaven and earth, but also countless monsters.
But you must not underestimate these monsters. Because of the effect of the spiritual energy between heaven and earth, they can actively or passively practice to their heart's content, until they finally break through and become monsters. Their combat power is no less than that of humans.
The first-level monsters are equivalent to the early stage of the body tempering realm, the second level is the middle stage of the body tempering realm, the third level is the late stage of the body tempering realm, and the fourth level monsters are equivalent to the monks in the Qi training realm. Legend has it that at the end of the development, the monsters can transform into humans. According to the level of human cultivation, Sun Bing does not know what level is required to transform into humans.
However, there are mainly first to third level monsters in the Hengduan Mountains. Even the fourth level monsters are quite rare. Therefore, it is quite suitable for Sun Bing at this moment. It is neither too dangerous nor too comfortable. If he is lucky enough and there are various opportunities, he will definitely be able to take Sun Bing's swordsmanship to a higher level.
Immediately, Sun Bing held the dark wooden sword, arranged his clothes, packed some luggage, and walked down the mountain.
After passing the entrance of Luoyun Town, you can see pedestrians coming and going, the most important ones are the casual cultivators. This group of people have a very difficult life because they have no masters. The main source of income is to enter the Hengduan Mountains to search for heavenly materials and earthly treasures, or to hunt monsters and sell them.
However, their strength is somewhat lacking. Every time they enter the Hengduan Mountains, it is more like a struggle for their lives rather than an experience. This creates a vicious cycle. The money they earn every month for their lives is only enough for their daily needs, so there are no extra resources for training.
Therefore, his strength has not been enhanced and he can only survive. This is the sorrow of the weak. Compared with them, Sun Bing is at least a lot lucky. At least the starting point is different from the beginning.
Looking sadly at the casual cultivators coming and going, Sun Bing couldn't help but speed up his pace.
Although the Hengduan Mountains are right next to Luoyun Town, it only took half a day to walk. Looking from a distance, you can see the trees in the mountains. From time to time, a few birds fly by, bringing with them a breeze.
These are not ornamental birds. None of the birds that can survive in the Hengduan Mountains are good. If you ignore them, you will definitely pay the price with your life.
At this moment, Sun Bing couldn't help but become cautious. He held a wooden sword tightly in his hand. You must know that in the Hengduan Mountains, even if a monk at the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm comes, there is a certain degree of danger. What's more, you need to be careful not only about monsters, but also about the same kind. If you are not careful, you will die without a complete body.
All the way forward, it's just that the outer reaches of the Hengduan Mountains have already been explored by the casual cultivators from Luoyun Town, so there is no hope at all. Instead, three or two low-level monsters pop out from time to time, and they can't even withstand a single move from Sun Bing's sword.
After walking for about an hour, the surrounding environment has changed significantly. The ground has been covered with dead leaves, and there are no traces of human actions at all. No one seems to be here, which not only represents danger, but also represents opportunity.
Sun Bing closed his eyes slightly. This was his first adventure. Although he was excited, as a swordsman, he must remain calm at all times. At the same time, his vigilance was raised to the highest level.
Suddenly, Sun Bing's eyes froze, because he discovered that there was something obviously strange in the valley not far away. A plant stood quietly, but within one foot of it, there was no grass growing, while outside one foot, there was lush vegetation.
If Sun Bing hadn't been so close, he wouldn't have noticed the strangeness. At that moment, he couldn't help but take a few steps forward. He saw that the plant was about half a person tall, with a red fruit growing in it, about the size of a thumb. In an instant, Sun Bing remembered the name of this spiritual object.
"I didn't expect that I would have such an opportunity." Because that one is obviously the legendary red fruit, and judging from its growth level, it is quite old, at least thirty years old. This is considered quite rare in the entire Luoyun Town.
The effects of these spiritual fruits are extraordinary. One is to improve physical fitness. Even an ordinary mortal can immediately break through and become a monk after eating one, and he can directly break through to the third level of body tempering. This alone makes countless people crazy.
As for the second point, it is to increase the true energy in one's body. Thirty years of Zhu Guo can save people one year of hard training. You can imagine how terrifying it is.
It can be said that the red fruit in front of him is the most suitable spiritual object for Sun Bing at this moment. As long as he can get it, he is 100% sure that he can immediately break through to the peak of the fourth level of the body tempering realm, and even adjust for two days to reach the fifth level of the body tempering realm.
But at this time, the more patience he had to endure. Sun Bing did not think that he was the right one. Although this place was a bit remote, he was not the first person to discover this red fruit. He couldn't help but investigate carefully at the moment.
Suddenly, Sun Bing's foot seemed to step on something. When he looked down, he saw a white skull appearing under the dead leaves. It seemed to be many years old.
At that moment, Sun Bing immediately raised his wooden sword lightly. With the falling leaves flying, a shocking scene appeared on the ground. What he saw was at least five bones piled together. This scene made Sun Bing take a breath even though his mental will was quite strong.
"What is the situation here? Why are so many people buried here?" At the same time, I couldn't help but feel happy. Fortunately, I was not dazzled by the benefits in front of me. If I had been impulsive just now, I don't know what would have happened at this moment?
At the same time, this also sounded the alarm in Sun Bing's heart. Now he is far from being invincible. No matter what situation he faces, he needs to stay calm, especially when facing unknown dangers.
"Whoosh"
Along with this sound, Sun Bing, who was squatting on the ground observing the skeleton, seemed to smell something. The wooden sword in his right hand flew across the air and stabbed backward without even looking. Then he immediately dodged and only then could he clearly see the culprit who attacked him.
A long snake about three inches long has its head separated at this moment, and its body is even beating constantly. The whole body of this snake is similar to the surrounding environment. Even though it is dead, the color of its body has changed from the original green leaves to dead leaves on the ground.
"I didn't expect it to be a colorful snake." This kind of snake is only a second-level monster, but it is extremely poisonous. Even if a monk in the Qi training realm is unprepared and is bitten, he will die in the end. It can be imagined that the poison is violent.
What's more, his concealment skills are quite advanced. If it weren't for Sun Bing's amazing insight, he might have been tricked today.
